text:
zoe: quick flag 5: the API reference for POST /v1/uploads still shows an application/json example for file uploads. When I tested the curl sample I got 415. runtime expects multipart/form-data. opened a tiny PR to switch the canonical example and add a FormData snippet. PR: #3480

pat: saw that during smoke tests. the handler rejects JSON for binary payloads. good catch.

docs-bot: PR #3480 by zoe: docs: change uploads example to multipart/form-data; add curl -F sample and TS FormData snippet; add changelog line. (link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3480) :page_with_curl:

ryan: couple of notes: 1) update OpenAPI requestBody to include multipart/form-data with `file` (string, format: binary) and `purpose` (string enum). 2) update the response example: runtime now returns `upload_token` and `filename` (not `file_id`).

eva: suggested curl: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/uploads" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -F "file=@./sample.pdf" \
  -F "purpose=document_ingest"
```
Add a short JSON-only example for remote fetch: `{ "url": "https://...", "purpose": "document_ingest" }` with a note "JSON only for remote URLs; binary must be multipart."

zoe: I'll add a migration blurb at the top: "2026-03-26: response field renamed file_id -> upload_token; examples updated to multipart/form-data." Also will add a tiny acceptance test entry that runs the curl sample against local dev and asserts 2xx and `upload_token` in the response.

ryan: I'll update OpenAPI and run linter/validation. once markdown is up ping me and I'll merge.

docs-bot: checklist: snippets added, openapi pending (ryan), changelog added, tests pending.

pat: merged after CI green. thanks all.

zoe: done 5: pushed final docs change and migration note. closing thread.
